paragraphs.source_en: The riding ground was ablaze with cherry blossoms, and the earth was already carpeted with fallen petals. paragraphs.source_en: Bewildered, Oharu followed behind Hirotada. Today was his wedding day. After riding hard at the training ground, there was nothing strange in bathing and grooming himself—but why put flowers in the tub? For Oharu, accompanying Hirotada to his bath was an ordeal. How would the young maids who had once served Hirotada alongside her look upon her now? The thought alone made Oharu shudder.
